g.text: PF-M. On baseline-failure dates, how much smaller (or larger) is W1's error? Paired differences with 95% intervals
Evidence D (panel request). Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not representative of all historical
Point = W1 MAE minus the comparison's MAE on the same baseline-failure station-dates; line = 95% paired circular block-bootstrap interval over target dates (14-day blocks, 2,000 resamples). An
interval entirely left of 0 means W1's smaller error is established on these dates. The grey control (average of persistence and climatology, no model) shows how much of any advantage a simple hedge
also gets. Rule and data as PF-L. Run panel-v3-20261025T104927Z-abfe4c.
